# STD-TEC-DOC-003: Site Configuration

**Standards Metadata**

```yaml
standard_id: 'STD-TEC-DOC-003'
standard_name: 'MkDocs Site Configuration'
standard_type: 'technology'
category: 'technology'
version: '1.0.0'
status: 'active'
compliance_level: 'mandatory'
tags: ['technology', 'mkdocs', 'site-configuration', 'mandatory']
```

---

> Defines standards for MkDocs site configuration within enterprise environments. Ensures consistent, maintainable, and professional documentation sites with proper theme configuration, plugin management, and site structure organization.

---
page_texts.3:
[standards/technology/mkdocs/STD-TEC-DOC-003-site-configuration.md#purpose]

## Purpose

This standard establishes requirements for configuring MkDocs sites within enterprise environments to ensure consistent, high-quality documentation sites that meet enterprise requirements for branding, accessibility, and performance.
page_texts.5:
[standards/technology/mkdocs/STD-TEC-DOC-003-site-configuration.md#21-required-mkdocsyml-structure]

### 2.1 Required mkdocs.yml Structure

**Minimum Configuration**:

```yaml
# Basic site information
site_name: 'Project Documentation'
site_description: 'Comprehensive documentation for Project Name'
site_author: 'Gainwell Technologies'
site_url: 'https://docs.project.gainwelltechnologies.com'

# Repository information
repo_name: 'mygainwell/project-name'
repo_url: 'https://github.com/mygainwell/project-name'
edit_uri: 'edit/main/docs/'

# Copyright and legal
copyright: '© 2025 Gainwell Technologies. All rights reserved.'

# Build directories
docs_dir: 'docs'
site_dir: 'site'
```
page_texts.6:
[standards/technology/mkdocs/STD-TEC-DOC-003-site-configuration.md#22-site-information-standards]

### 2.2 Site Information Standards

**Required Fields**:

- `site_name`: Clear, descriptive project name
- `site_description`: Brief, SEO-friendly description
- `site_author`: "Gainwell Technologies" (standardized)
- `site_url`: Canonical URL for the documentation
- `repo_name`: GitHub repository identifier
- `repo_url`: Full repository URL
- `copyright`: Standardized copyright notice
page_texts.8:
[standards/technology/mkdocs/STD-TEC-DOC-003-site-configuration.md#31-material-theme-setup]

### 3.1 Material Theme Setup

**Standard Theme Configuration**:

```yaml
theme:
    name: material
    language: en

    # Color scheme
    palette:
        - scheme: default
          primary: blue
          accent: blue
          toggle:
              icon: material/brightness-7
              name: Switch to dark mode
        - scheme: slate
          primary: blue
          accent: blue
          toggle:
              icon: material/brightness-4
              name: Switch to light mode

    # Typography
    font:
        text: Roboto
        code: Roboto Mono

    # Logo and favicon
    logo: assets/images/logo.png
    favicon: assets/favicon.ico

    # Features
    features:
        - navigation.tabs
        - navigation.sections
        - navigation.expand
        - navigation.top
        - search.highlight
        - search.share
        - content.code.copy
        - content.code.annotate
```
page_texts.9:
[standards/technology/mkdocs/STD-TEC-DOC-003-site-configuration.md#32-brand-consistency]

### 3.2 Brand Consistency

**Logo Requirements**:

- **Format**: PNG with transparent background
- **Size**: 128x128 pixels minimum
- **Location**: `docs/assets/images/logo.png`
- **Favicon**: Corresponding ICO format

**Color Palette**:

- **Primary**: Gainwell Blue (#1976D2)
- **Accent**: Complementary blue shade
- **Supporting**: Enterprise-approved color scheme
page_texts.10:
[standards/technology/mkdocs/STD-TEC-DOC-003-site-configuration.md#33-navigation-features]

### 3.3 Navigation Features

**Required Features**:

```yaml
features:
    - navigation.tabs # Top-level navigation tabs
    - navigation.sections # Collapsible sections
    - navigation.expand # Auto-expand navigation
    - navigation.top # Back to top button
    - navigation.indexes # Section index pages
    - toc.integrate # Integrated table of contents
    - search.highlight # Search term highlighting
    - search.share # Search result sharing
    - content.code.copy # Code block copy button
    - content.code.annotate # Code annotations
```
page_texts.12:
[standards/technology/mkdocs/STD-TEC-DOC-003-site-configuration.md#41-essential-plugins]

### 4.1 Essential Plugins

**Required Plugins**:

```yaml
plugins:
    - search:
          lang: en
          separator: '[\s\-,:!=\[\]()"/]+|(?!\b)(?=[A-Z][a-z])|\.(?!\d)|&[lg]t;'

    - git-revision-date-localized:
          type: datetime
          timezone: America/New_York
          locale: en
          enable_creation_date: true

    - git-authors:
          show_contribution: true
          show_line_count: true
          count_empty_lines: false

    - awesome-pages:
          filename: .pages
          collapse_single_pages: true
          strict: false

    - macros:
          include_dir: docs/includes
          include_yaml:
              - docs/data/variables.yml
```
page_texts.13:
[standards/technology/mkdocs/STD-TEC-DOC-003-site-configuration.md#42-performance-plugins]

### 4.2 Performance Plugins

**Optimization Plugins**:

```yaml
plugins:
    - minify:
          minify_html: true
          minify_js: true
          minify_css: true
          htmlmin_opts:
              remove_comments: true
              remove_empty_space: true
              reduce_boolean_attributes: true

    - optimize:
          enabled: !ENV [OPTIMIZE, false]
          cache: true
          cache_dir: .cache/optimize
          optimize_png: true
          optimize_jpg: true
          optimize_svg: true
```
page_texts.14:
[standards/technology/mkdocs/STD-TEC-DOC-003-site-configuration.md#43-development-plugins]

### 4.3 Development Plugins

**Development-Only Plugins**:

```yaml
plugins:
    - print-site:
          enabled: !ENV [ENABLE_PDF, false]
          add_to_navigation: true
          print_page_title: 'Print'

    - redirects:
          redirect_maps:
              'old-page.md': 'new-page.md'
              'legacy/': 'current/'
```
page_texts.16:
[standards/technology/mkdocs/STD-TEC-DOC-003-site-configuration.md#51-navigation-definition]

### 5.1 Navigation Definition

**Standard Navigation**:

```yaml
nav:
    - Home: index.md
    - Getting Started:
          - Overview: getting-started/index.md
          - Installation: getting-started/installation.md
          - Quick Start: getting-started/quick-start.md
    - User Guide:
          - Tutorials: user-guide/tutorials.md
          - How-to Guides: user-guide/how-to.md
          - FAQ: user-guide/faq.md
    - API Reference:
          - Overview: api/index.md
          - Endpoints: api/endpoints.md
          - Examples: api/examples.md
    - Developer:
          - Contributing: developer/contributing.md
          - Architecture: developer/architecture.md
          - Deployment: developer/deployment.md
    - About:
          - Release Notes: about/releases.md
          - License: about/license.md
          - Contact: about/contact.md
```
page_texts.17:
[standards/technology/mkdocs/STD-TEC-DOC-003-site-configuration.md#52-page-metadata]

### 5.2 Page Metadata

**Required Front Matter**:

```yaml
---
title: 'Page Title'
description: 'Page description for SEO'
tags:
    - tag1
    - tag2
template: custom.html # if needed
hide:
    - navigation # if needed
    - toc # if needed
---
```
page_texts.19:
[standards/technology/mkdocs/STD-TEC-DOC-003-site-configuration.md#61-essential-extensions]

### 6.1 Essential Extensions

**Required Extensions**:

```yaml
markdown_extensions:
    # Python Markdown
    - abbr
    - admonition
    - attr_list
    - def_list
    - footnotes
    - md_in_html
    - toc:
          permalink: true
          title: 'On this page'

    # PyMdown Extensions
    - pymdownx.arithmatex:
          generic: true
    - pymdownx.betterem:
          smart_enable: all
    - pymdownx.caret
    - pymdownx.details
    - pymdownx.emoji:
          emoji_generator: !!python/name:materialx.emoji.to_svg
          emoji_index: !!python/name:materialx.emoji.twemoji
    - pymdownx.highlight:
          anchor_linenums: true
          line_spans: __span
          pygments_lang_class: true
    - pymdownx.inlinehilite
    - pymdownx.keys
    - pymdownx.mark
    - pymdownx.smartsymbols
    - pymdownx.superfences:
          custom_fences:
              - name: mermaid
                class: mermaid
                format: !!python/name:pymdownx.superfences.fence_code_format
    - pymdownx.tabbed:
          alternate_style: true
    - pymdownx.tasklist:
          custom_checkbox: true
    - pymdownx.tilde
```
page_texts.20:
[standards/technology/mkdocs/STD-TEC-DOC-003-site-configuration.md#62-code-highlighting]

### 6.2 Code Highlighting

**Syntax Highlighting Setup**:

```yaml
markdown_extensions:
    - pymdownx.highlight:
          anchor_linenums: true
          line_spans: __span
          pygments_lang_class: true
          auto_title: true
          linenums: true
    - pymdownx.inlinehilite
    - pymdownx.snippets:
          check_paths: true
          base_path: docs/snippets
```
page_texts.22:
[standards/technology/mkdocs/STD-TEC-DOC-003-site-configuration.md#71-seo-configuration]

### 7.1 SEO Configuration

**Search Engine Optimization**:

```yaml
extra:
    # SEO
    social:
        - icon: fontawesome/brands/github
          link: https://github.com/mygainwell
        - icon: fontawesome/brands/linkedin
          link: https://linkedin.com/company/gainwell-technologies

    # Analytics
    analytics:
        provider: google
        property: G-XXXXXXXXXX
        feedback:
            title: Was this page helpful?
            ratings:
                - icon: material/emoticon-happy-outline
                  name: This page was helpful
                  data: 1
                  note: Thanks for your feedback!
                - icon: material/emoticon-sad-outline
                  name: This page could be improved
                  data: 0
                  note: Tell us how we can improve this page.
```
page_texts.23:
[standards/technology/mkdocs/STD-TEC-DOC-003-site-configuration.md#72-version-information]

### 7.2 Version Information

**Version Management**:

```yaml
extra:
    version:
        provider: mike
        default: stable

    # Version warning for dev builds
    version_warning: !ENV [VERSION_WARNING, false]
```
page_texts.25:
[standards/technology/mkdocs/STD-TEC-DOC-003-site-configuration.md#81-local-development]

### 8.1 Local Development

**Development Server Settings**:

```yaml
# Development configuration
dev_addr: '127.0.0.1:8000'
use_directory_urls: true
strict: true

# Live reload
watch:
    - docs
    - mkdocs.yml
    - overrides
```
page_texts.26:
[standards/technology/mkdocs/STD-TEC-DOC-003-site-configuration.md#82-validation-rules]

### 8.2 Validation Rules

**Content Validation**:

```yaml
validation:
    nav:
        omitted_files: warn
        not_found: warn
        absolute_links: warn
    links:
        not_found: warn
        absolute_links: warn
        unrecognized_links: warn
```
page_texts.28:
[standards/technology/mkdocs/STD-TEC-DOC-003-site-configuration.md#91-performance-settings]

### 9.1 Performance Settings

**Build Optimization**:

```yaml
# Performance settings
site_dir: site
docs_dir: docs
use_directory_urls: true

# Optimization plugins
plugins:
    - optimize:
          enabled: !ENV [OPTIMIZE, true]
          cache: true
          optimize_png: true
          optimize_jpg: true

    - minify:
          minify_html: true
          minify_js: true
          minify_css: true
```
page_texts.29:
[standards/technology/mkdocs/STD-TEC-DOC-003-site-configuration.md#92-caching-strategy]

### 9.2 Caching Strategy

**Build Caching**:

```yaml
# Cache configuration
cache_dir: .cache
cache_time: 3600

# Asset optimization
extra_css:
    - stylesheets/extra.css
extra_javascript:
    - javascripts/extra.js
```
page_texts.31:
[standards/technology/mkdocs/STD-TEC-DOC-003-site-configuration.md#101-production-configuration]

### 10.1 Production Configuration

**Production Settings**:

```yaml
# Production-only configuration
extra:
    analytics:
        provider: google
        property: G-PRODUCTION-ID

    # CDN configuration
    cdn:
        enabled: true
        provider: cloudfront
        domain: cdn.docs.gainwelltechnologies.com
```
page_texts.32:
[standards/technology/mkdocs/STD-TEC-DOC-003-site-configuration.md#102-development-environment]

### 10.2 Development Environment

**Development Overrides**:

```yaml
# Development environment
plugins:
    - search
    - git-revision-date-localized:
          enabled: !ENV [CI, false]
    - print-site:
          enabled: false

# Debug settings
debug: !ENV [DEBUG, false]
strict: !ENV [STRICT, true]
```
page_texts.33:
[standards/technology/mkdocs/STD-TEC-DOC-003-site-configuration.md#103-cicd-integration]

### 10.3 CI/CD Integration

**Build Pipeline Configuration**:

```yaml
# CI/CD specific settings
hooks:
    - hooks/build_extras.py
    - hooks/validate_content.py

# Environment variables
extra:
    build_date: !ENV BUILD_DATE
    commit_hash: !ENV GITHUB_SHA
    branch: !ENV GITHUB_REF_NAME
```
